_note: Dated cost rates for index OPTIONS, Upstox (percent values are written as percent, e.g. "0.1" = 0.1%; sebi_per_crore is rupees per crore). EVERY rate is "unverified": seeded from NSE circulars, the Finance Acts as quoted by NSE, and Upstox's published rate card (Wayback snapshots), not from a contract note. Approved by the user after checking NSE/FATAX/73524 and NSE/FA/64232 on nseindia.com. Decisions: IPFT and GST on it from 2023-04-01; Upstox's Rs 10 API-order promotion is ignored (Rs 20 flat, see PROGRESS.md Phase 7 note). Unchanged since 2022: brokerage Rs 20 flat, SEBI Rs 10/crore, stamp 0.003% (buy), GST 18%. Dates before 2022-01-01 raise NoRatesForDate. When a real contract note matches to the paisa (test_7d), flip the rates to "verified".

rows.note: Base row (start of the study window). NSE IPFT contribution was Rs 0.01 per crore (0.0000001%): ignored, worth Rs 0.00008 on a Rs 7,500 trade.
